sections.overview: About **20 hours** to 100%. Two achievements are missable; nothing is online.
sections.route:
1. Story, scanning each system as you go.
2. Pick the quiet answer at the end.
3. Mop up relics, then a chapter 2 pacifist run.
4. Nightmare last.
sections.missables: Cartographer closes after chapter 6; The Quiet Part is the last choice.
sections.combos: Cartographer and Collector share the same sweep.

walkthrough.title: Chapter 1: Ember Station
walkthrough.text: Light the first beacon on the way out of the station. The tutorial is short; nothing here can be missed.

walkthrough.title: Chapters 2-5: The Veil
walkthrough.text: Scan every system the first time you pass it; the map marks the ones left. Chapter 2 is the shortest, so try the pacifist run there.

walkthrough.title: Chapter 6: The Collapse
walkthrough.text: The Veil closes for good when the chapter starts: finish scanning first. Relics glow on the map once a system is scanned.

walkthrough.title: The last choice
walkthrough.text: Pick the quiet answer at the end. Save before the final conversation.

walkthrough.title: After the credits
walkthrough.text: Nightmare with every upgrade carried over.
